cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the addressing system covers the whole country; use by water and electricity services in N'Djamena does not answer that.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-23 (a stage needs every lower rung shown by its own evidence): N'Djamena's street numbering, official since 2016 and used to locate utility subscribers, is a city system in service; nothing found says it covers the country, so its use no longer lifts the cell to 5.
